item.title: Lego Robotics for Elementary Students — Sat Oct 10, 1:00 PM — RecRoom
item.description: LEGO Robotics for Elementary Kids (Grades K–5) LEGO Robotics at Kinetic Minds introduces kids to engineering and beginner coding through hands-on building, testing, and problem-solving using LEGO robotics kits. In this small-group, drop-in friendly workshop, kids work in pairs to build real robots, program simple behaviors, and improve their designs through guided challenges. The focus is on curiosity, experimentation, and learning how things work—there’s no single “right” build and no step-by-step cookie-cutter instructions. Workshops are intentionally capped at a low student-to-instructor ratio to support collaboration, confidence, and meaningful learning. Kids will explore: • Engineering and building with LEGO robotics components • Beginner coding concepts (motors, sensors, cause and effect) • Testing, debugging, and iterating designs • Teamwork, communication, and explaining ideas Details: • 60-minute session • Small-group format • No prior experience required Community Spons

item.title: The Assembly of Lovers - Sufi Drum Circle — Mon Oct 12, 7:00 PM — the Space
item.description: Community drum and chant circle rooted in Sufi prayer. Meets every other Monday: September 28, October 12, etc. Contribution: Sliding scale donation $20–$40 (no one will be turned away) This is a vibrant Community Drum and Chanting Circle, where we drum and chant from our hearts into the universe. This experience is open to absolutely everyone, regardless of background or belief system—all that’s required is an open heart and a willingness to connect through sound. The term ‘lover’ in this context refers to seekers on the Sufi path who are longing for union with the divine energy. You can think of this gathering as an expansion of the sema sufi meditations we used to offer. It is looser in form, more focused on music, and does not necessarily involve whirling, although it is welcome if you are called to it. There is a rhythm older than thought.
